rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for feeling sad or experiencing grief.

example.english: I still grieve when I think about what happened.
example.traditional: 諗起件事，我仲係好難過。
example.jyutping: nam2 hei2 gin6 si6 ngo5 zung6 hai6 hou2 naan4 gwo3

rows.note: Use this for deeper emotional pain, especially when grieving a loss or an unhappy fate.

example.english: They grieve deeply after losing their grandmother.
example.traditional: 失去阿嫲之後，佢成日都好傷心。
example.jyutping: sat1 heoi3 aa3 maa4 zi1 hau6 keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1

rows.note: Use this mainly when formally mourning someone who has died, rather than for ordinary sadness.

example.english: The public gathered in the square to grieve for the victims.
example.traditional: 市民聚集喺廣場，向遇難者表示哀悼。
example.jyutping: si5 man4 zeoi6 zaap6 hai2 gwong2 coeng4 hoeng3 jyu6 naan6 ze2 biu2 si6 oi1 dou6
